notes.title: MvsM Closed Beta: The First Step to Conquering the World!
notes.notes:
Excitement Awaits! MvsM Closed Beta is Here!

Welcome to the closed beta phase of MvsM! In this special event, you’ll have the opportunity to explore the newest features and unique mechanics of the game before anyone else. Your participation will not only contribute to the development of the game but also give you a chance to test your strategy and skills in a global community.

What’s Waiting for You?

New Characters and Abilities: Captivating heroes with unique stories and gameplay styles.
Exclusive Beta Map: A one-of-a-kind arena you’ve never seen before.
Leaderboard: Rewards and surprise gifts for top-performing players!
By joining this event, you’ll become part of the community shaping the future of MvsM. Your feedback will play a crucial role in determining how the game evolves!

Don’t miss this exclusive experience and secure your spot in the battle arena for the new year!

Closed Beta Start Date: July 20, 2025

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Developer Stream
notes.notes:
To celebrate our participation in the Steam Next Fest, we are excited to stream the demo of Mvsm (Magic Versus Mind) directly on our store page!

You can create your own fighter by trying out various skills and weapons. The most important question here is, which side will you choose: Will you join the Magicians or the Technology Team?

We will also answer all your questions about the game, and you will have the opportunity to play with the development team.

The stream starts on June 12, 2024, at 11:00 PM (TSI) / 8:00 PM (CET) / 3:00 PM (EST).

See you there!

notes.title: MvsM (Magic Versus Mind) be in Steam's Endless Replayability Fest on May 13-20
notes.notes:
MvsM (Magic Versus Mind) will be in Steam's Endless Replayability Festival from May 13th to 20th

[url=https://i.hizliresim.com/awi0mlu.png][img]https://i.hizliresim.com/awi0mlu.png[/img][/url]

Throughout this festival, we will be hosting live streams and Q&A sessions. These sessions will provide a perfect opportunity for you to get a glimpse into the development processes of MvsM and all our future projects.

Keep following our social media accounts for detailed information on the streaming dates. We are excited to embark on this journey of growth and improvement with you. May your dreams always come true!
